## SEARCH-1 Result Report

Implemented normalized tags for cards and card forms, with tag persistence wired through capture, topic creation, and card detail editing.

### Files created

- `src/domain/tags.ts` — `normalizeTag` re-export, `addTag`, `removeTag`, `validateTagSet`, tag limits, duplicate and casing rules.
- `src/features/search/TagInput.tsx` — accessible controlled tag editor.
- `src/features/search/TagInput.css` — token-only tag chip, counter, status, focus, and 44px target styling.
- `tests/domain/tags.test.ts` — domain tag rule coverage.
- `tests/search/TagInput.test.tsx` — keyboard, announcement, target, form wiring, and card-detail reload coverage.

### Files changed

- `src/features/capture/NoteSourceForm.tsx` — tags field and optional `tags` in submitted values.
- `src/features/capture/TopicForm.tsx` — tags field and optional `tags` in submitted values.
- `src/features/capture/CapturePage.tsx` — carries tags through pending drafts and forwards them to `importImageCard` / `createCard`.
- `src/features/cards/CardDetailPage.tsx` — `Edit tags` dialog using `TagInput`, saved through `updateCard`.
- `src/features/cards/CardDetail.css` — tag header/edit control layout with token-only values.
- `tests/capture/CaptureFlow.test.tsx` — source and topic capture flows now assert persisted tags.
- `tests/capture/TopicForm.test.tsx` — tab order updated for the new tag field.

### Validation

- `npm test -- tests/domain/tags.test.ts tests/search/TagInput.test.tsx` — **pass**, 25 tests.
- `npm run typecheck` — **pass**.
- Additional checks: full suite **676/676 pass**, `npm run lint` pass, Prettier check pass, `npm run build` pass.

### Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Trim, reject over 24 chars, reject eleventh tag, case-insensitive dedupe | Pass | `tags.test.ts`, `TagInput.test.tsx` |
| First display casing preserved; duplicates do not replace it | Pass | `addTag` duplicate result and duplicate UI test |
| Enter/comma add, Backspace removes last, errors announced | Pass | `TagInput.test.tsx` keyboard tests and persistent live status region |
| Tags persist on notes, sources, topics and survive reload | Pass | CaptureFlow source/topic repository assertions; CardDetail save + unmount/reload test |
| Remove controls 44px with accessible names | Pass | CSS contract test against `--target-min`; `Remove tag <name>` buttons |

### Keyboard path exercised

- Tab from title → tag input → actions in note/source and topic forms.
- Enter and comma add; Backspace removes last; Tab to individual remove buttons; Enter activates removal.
- Card detail: `Edit tags` opens the shared dialog, saves tags, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.

### Viewports exercised

- Component/domain tests are jsdom-based. No browser viewport matrix was required for SEARCH-1; phone/tablet browser evidence remains with SEARCH-3/QA. Responsive wrapping is implemented at `max-width: 600px` but was not Playwright-verified here.

### Accessibility evidence

- Tag remove controls use the shared `IconButton` with 44×44 `--target-min` sizing and explicit token focus rings.
- Tag input has a visible label, hint, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-errormessage`, and a permanently mounted polite status region.
- Focus returns to the tag input after removing a chip; the card-detail dialog traps focus while open and restores the `Edit tags` trigger on save/Escape.
- Measured token contrast: muted text on surface **7.87:1**, danger text on surface **8.72:1**, tag text on sunken surface **13.50:1**.
- No raw palette literals or `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in the new tag UI.

### Shared-file handoff

- `CapturePage.tsx`: `PendingCard` and `PendingTopic` now require `tags`; preserve forwarding to `importImageCard` and `createCard`, including retry drafts.
- `CardDetailPage.tsx`: tag edits must continue to go through `updateCard` only; title, photo, type, and position stay untouched by the tags dialog.
- `NoteSourceForm.tsx` / `TopicForm.tsx`: `tags` remains optional when empty for existing caller compatibility.
- `src/domain/tags.ts` re-exports `normalizeTag` from `src/domain/validation.ts` to keep one authoritative normalization rule; `data-engineer` should preserve that single source during review.
